g.title: Stage3
g.text: Restaurant Rush Stage 3 | Final UML class diagram
Key members shown; reference fields are represented by named association ends.

g.title: Waiter
g.text: + takeOrder(t: Table, i: MenuItem, id: int): Order
+ takeOrder(t: Table, i: MenuItem, id: int, billCents: int): Order

g.title: MenuItem
g.text: + MenuItem(name: String, priceCents: int, prepUnits: int)

g.title: Order
g.text: + Order(orderId: int, item: MenuItem, billCents: int)

g.title: Encapsulation
g.text: Customer satisfaction is private; recovery is capped at 100.
Order billCents is final and is read at payment.

g.title: Polymorphism
g.text: orderFood() dispatch to VIP / Critic overrides.
ComboMeal is accepted wherever MenuItem is expected.

g.title: CompositionNote
g.text: Controller creates and owns its policy, staff and two tables.
ComboMeal has two shared component references; hollow
diamond denotes aggregation, not exclusive lifetime ownership.

g.title: Legend
g.text: Hollow triangle: inheritance; filled diamond: composition.
Solid arrow: navigable association; dashed: dependency.
Routine controller getters and repeated inherited members omitted.
